messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Restyle the person's hair to match the hairstyle shown in the reference images, using the front and back reference views for the hairstyle shape. Use the reference images only for the hairstyle. Keep the person's identity, hair color, clothing, and all other aspects of the current video unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please return to the version where the person has black hair and apply the following edit to that version: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please restyle the person's hair according to the reference images. Use the reference images only for the hairstyle. Keep the person's identity, hair color, clothing, and all other aspects of the current video unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The person stands still facing the water, then begins to walk forward slowly toward the edge of the platform.","camera":"The camera is positioned behind the person at a low angle, initially showing a full-body shot that gradually zooms in to a medium shot of the upper body and head.","clothing":"The person wears a matching two-piece suit with a brown, orange, and black checkered pattern, including a jacket and trousers, along with dark shoes.","hair_color":"The hair is dark brown or black.","hairstyle":"The person's hair is pulled back into a high ponytail or bun.","identity":"A person with a medium-dark complexion is seen from behind, with a slim build and visible ears.","scene":"The setting is an outdoor stone platform or terrace overlooking a calm body of water, possibly the sea, under a clear blue sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The person's hair was changed from a small top bun to a long, high ponytail that hangs down the back, matching the reference hairstyle. The rest of the scene, clothing, action, and camera movement appear largely unchanged.
arguments.requested_change: Restyle the person's hair to match the reference images, using only the hairstyle shape while keeping identity, hair color, clothing, and all other video aspects unchanged.
uncertain: Whether the hair color remained exactly the same as the source, since the new ponytail is dark and the source hair was also dark but not directly comparable in all frames.
unexpected_changes: The output frames have visible black letterbox bars on the left and right edges, which were not present in the source frames.
